services.name: Guided Heli-Fishing
services.desc: A Unique Heli-Fishing Adventure in BC Overview The ultimate small group heli-fishing experience. Officially known as Winslow Lake, this small, emerald-green lake is home to countless hungry Cutthroat Trout, and the occasional lunker Bull Trout. Enjoy the tranquility of this hidden paradise with your friends, family, or co-workers. Dig your feet in the white sand and cast from shore or hop in one of our inflatable angler kayaks. Appreciate the rugged landscapes that surround the lake and enjoy this once-in-a-lifetime heli-fishing experience. Keep an eye on the shoreline as there is a good chance you will see wildlife. services.name: Elopements and Engagements
services.desc: Elopements and Engagements Overview Say it at the summit. Contact us today to plan your perfect wilderness elopement or proposal. Bring your own officiant and photographer or let us supply them for you We are the only operator in British Columbia with tenured crown land approved for wilderness elopements and engagements. Choose an epic location from one of five lakes, a glacier, beautiful alpine ridges, or a volcano! All these experiences are private, and guests enjoy exclusive use of the helicopter. Just you and up to three adventure friends. For custom unforgettable backcountry adventures, do not hesitate to send an enquiry. The possibilities are endless. Duration 2 Hours What’s Included:

services.name: Golden Ears Provincial Park Sightseeing
services.desc: Golden Ears Provincial Park Tour Duration 1 Hour Overview This trip departs from Fort Langley Airport and soars over Alouette lake, past the Golden Ears group of peaks (Edge Peak and Blanshard Peak) before continuing up Gold Creek towards Mount Robie Reid and Mount Judge Howay, the two tallest mountains in the park. Take in the spectacular views of the park, admiring the sprawling landscape of temperate rainforests and mountain vistas before returning to base. The tour includes 1 hour of flight time and unparalleled views of Golden Ears Provincial Park. All of these experiences are private, and guests enjoy exclusive use of the helicopter. services.name: Vancouver Sightseeing
services.desc: Vancouver Sightseeing Tour Duration 1 Hour Overview See Vancouver and the North Shore Mountains like never before on this 1 hour sightseeing experience. Incredible views can be had immediately after take off from our base in Fort Langley. During your flight you’ll see Fort Langley, Pitt Meadows, Coquitlam, Deep Cove, Indian Arm, the downtown core, False Creek, Stanley Park, West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Cypress Mountain, Grouse Mountain, Seymour Mountain and much more! This experience can be enjoyed year round. Please dress appropriately for the weather conditions. All of these experiences are private, and guests enjoy exclusive use of the helicopter.
